name: mary
description: Mary Morbus (Fall from Heaven), the plague hero of the Ashen Veil: a hunched undead girl with pale grey-green skin, tiny glowing yellow eyes and a long curtain of stringy black hair over her head and shoulders, in a torn, dirty white nightgown with sickly green stains, thin grey-green limbs, one twisted bandaged leg, and a few floating yellow-green plague blobs around her; she has no weapon and strikes with the long claw nails of her LEFT hand
hands: she has no weapon: her clawed left hand on the screen-right side reaches forward and is the one that strikes, its claw nails just past the fingers, and her right hand on the screen-left side is an empty clawed hand hanging at her side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the clawed left hand is raised up over the head, its long claw nails pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the clawed left hand cocked back behind the head with its long claw nails spread, the empty clawed right hand tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the clawed left arm sweeps over the head and is level, its long claw nails pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: the clawed left arm fully extended toward the lower-right, its long claw nails raking down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty clawed right hand swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the clawed left hand carries on down until its claw nails nearly touch the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the long black hair trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the clawed left hand lifts back toward its reaching rest

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, tiny yellow eyes squeezed shut, the long black hair whipping back, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty clawed right hand flung out to the left, the clawed left hand thrown out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the clawed left hand dipping, the clawed right hand still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, the clawed left hand flung up above her shoulder, the empty clawed right hand drooping, the green plague blobs scattering
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops behind the curtain of black hair, the clawed left hand lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the clawed left hand still held out in front of her at knee height with its claw nails drooping, the empty clawed right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, both clawed hands go limp and empty, legs slide forward, the black hair flying
death.5: hits the ground: lying on her back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the long black hair fanned out on the ground; both clawed hands limp and empty; the torn white nightgown spread under her
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the black hair settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on her back, eyes closed, clawed hands limp at her sides, a few green plague blobs fading on the ground beside her
